description: Runtime-parity corpus for unicode/utf8.Valid (structured sweeps over every byte class boundary, plus random strings) and unicode.IsSpace (every code point, U+0000 to U+10FFFF).

sweeps: byte set per position (all: 0x00-0xff; boundaries; boundariesHigh: boundaries >= 0xe0; continuation)
sha256 of the verdict bytes in lexicographic order
valid count per first byte, in the order of the first position's set
